stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS (fall 2023 entering class, ADM2023). UW-Superior's Common Data Set is linked from its institutional research page but sits behind a Microsoft sign-in and could not be read, so CDS figures (international applicants/admits, GPA) are not added. IPEDS reports ACT only (no SAT). College Navigator for fall 2024 shows 1,517 applicants, 93% admitted, 19% of admits enrolled.

cost.notes: UW-Superior international page, 2026-27 estimate for full-time on-campus students: nonresident tuition and fees $18,155; most affordable double room with a 13-meal plan $7,945 (room_board_usd; the page suggests $1,285 more for extra meals); required health insurance $2,255 (other_usd); books about $1,090; orientation fee $255 once. total_coa_usd is the page's minimum funding to show for an F-1 visa without a scholarship ($32,385; it also includes personal expenses). With the NTW scholarship the page's total is $22,710 or $20,510.
